title: US Government Moves to Let Private Companies Hack Foreign Criminals
subtitle: A new program aims to use private businesses to fight cybercrime, but experts raise concerns about safety and legal risks.

summary.en: The Trump administration has announced a plan to allow private companies to conduct cyberattacks against foreign criminals. This program marks a major change in how the U.S. handles digital threats. Participating firms will work under contracts with the Department of Justice or the Department of Homeland Security. Experts are questioning how these companies will be managed and what legal rules they must follow. The move has sparked debate about the risks of letting private businesses perform tasks usually reserved for the government.
summary.zh: 川普政府宣布了一項計畫，允許民間企業對外國犯罪分子進行網路攻擊。此計畫標誌著美國處理數位威脅方式的重大改變。參與的企業將在與司法部或國土安全部簽訂的合約下運作。專家們質疑這些公司將如何被管理，以及必須遵守哪些法律規範。此舉引發了關於讓民間企業執行通常由政府保留之任務所帶來風險的辯論。

paragraphs.en: The Trump administration has introduced a new program that could change how the United States handles digital threats. According to NPR News, the government is creating a system to allow private companies to hack into the networks of foreign cybercriminals. This plan represents a significant shift in policy, as such work has traditionally been performed only by government agencies.
paragraphs.zh: 川普政府推出了一項新計畫，可能會改變美國處理數位威脅的方式。根據美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，政府正在建立一套系統，允許民間企業駭入外國網路犯罪分子的系統。這項計畫代表政策上的重大轉變，因為這類工作傳統上僅由政府機構執行。

paragraphs.en: This announcement follows previous reports from earlier this week about the government's intention to authorize private firms to carry out cyberattacks. Under the new plan, companies will not act on their own. Instead, they must sign contracts with the Department of Justice or the Department of Homeland Security. These companies will undergo a process called “rigorous vetting,” which means the government will carefully check their background and abilities before allowing them to participate. Additionally, companies must set aside $1 million, which the government can take if the company fails to follow the rules of the contract.
paragraphs.zh: 此項公告是在本週稍早傳出政府有意授權民間公司執行網路攻擊的相關報導後發布的。根據這項新計畫，企業不得擅自行動，必須與司法部或國土安全部簽訂合約。這些公司將接受所謂的「嚴格審查」，這意味著政府在允許其參與前，會仔細核查其背景與能力。此外，企業必須預留一百萬美元的保證金，若公司未能遵守合約規定，政府可將其沒收。

paragraphs.en: Joshua Steinman, who worked on cyber policy for the National Security Council during President Trump’s first term, noted that this program could target groups involved in organized crime or money laundering. He suggested that many companies might see this as a way to gain more government work and improve their reputation. However, the exact details of how these companies will be chosen, or how the government will select which foreign groups to attack, remain unclear. The presidential memo does not fully explain how private businesses will take the lead on tasks like spying or disrupting computer systems, which are usually handled by the state.
paragraphs.zh: 曾在川普第一任期內負責國家安全會議網路政策的史坦曼（Joshua Steinman）指出，這項計畫可能針對涉及組織犯罪或洗錢的團體。他認為許多公司可能會將此視為爭取更多政府業務並提升聲譽的途徑。然而，這些公司將如何被挑選，以及政府將如何選擇攻擊哪些外國團體，目前細節仍不明朗。總統備忘錄並未完整說明民間企業將如何主導如間諜活動或破壞電腦系統等通常由國家處理的任務。

paragraphs.en: While the idea has received support from some who believe it will help the U.S. fight back against digital threats, others are more cautious. Arthur Tellis, a former Department of Defense staffer, believes that private companies might be better at watching criminals than actually stopping them. He pointed out that these firms are likely looking for opportunities to increase their visibility or get more resources from the government. Some experts also worry about the legal side of the plan. Current U.S. laws generally stop people and businesses from hacking into computer networks, with only a few exceptions for law enforcement. The new memo does not change these laws, which creates questions about how these private attacks will be justified in court.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然此構想獲得部分人士支持，認為這有助於美國對抗數位威脅，但其他人則持保留態度。前國防部官員泰利斯（Arthur Tellis）認為，民間企業在監控犯罪分子方面或許表現較佳，但未必能真正阻止他們。他指出，這些公司很可能只是在尋找增加曝光度或從政府獲取更多資源的機會。部分專家也對該計畫的法律層面感到擔憂。現行美國法律通常禁止個人與企業駭入電腦網路，僅對執法單位有少數例外。這份新備忘錄並未修改這些法律，這引發了這些民間攻擊在法庭上將如何被正當化的質疑。

paragraphs.en: This initiative has been compared by some to the concept of “privateers.” In the 16th century, privateers were private ships that were given permission by a government to attack enemy vessels during times of war. While the current memo does not give private companies the same level of freedom as historical privateers, the idea has gained interest among some lawmakers. Two Republican congressmen have already proposed legislation that would encourage this kind of partnership between the government and private firms to take the fight to foreign hackers.
paragraphs.zh: 有些人將此倡議比作「私掠船」的概念。在十六世紀，私掠船是指在戰爭時期獲得政府許可，得以攻擊敵方船隻的民間船隻。雖然目前的備忘錄並未給予民間企業與歷史上私掠船同等的自由度，但此構想已引起部分國會議員的興趣。兩位共和黨籍國會議員已提出法案，鼓勵政府與民間企業建立這種合作關係，以對外國駭客發動反擊。

paragraphs.en: Despite the interest, there are still many unanswered questions. It is not yet clear which companies will actually want to take part in this program. Historically, private corporations have worked with the federal government, but they have usually played a support role rather than acting as digital saboteurs. The government has not yet provided clear information on the types of attacks that will be allowed or how it will prevent these private actions from causing unintended problems. As the administration moves forward, the public and industry experts will be watching closely to see how the government manages the risks of letting private businesses enter the world of international cyber operations.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管各界對此感興趣，仍有許多問題懸而未決。目前尚不清楚哪些公司會真正有意參與此計畫。從歷史上看，民間企業雖曾與聯邦政府合作，但通常扮演支援角色，而非擔任數位破壞者。政府尚未提供關於允許何種攻擊類型，或如何防止這些民間行動造成非預期問題的明確資訊。隨著政府持續推動此計畫，大眾與產業專家將密切關注政府如何管理讓民間企業進入國際網路行動領域所帶來的風險。

options.C: Government officials who oversee private contracts.
options.D: Foreign hackers who steal information from private companies.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此上下文中，「saboteurs」意指「破壞者」，用來形容進行數位攻擊（digital saboteurs）的角色。文章提到企業過去僅扮演支援角色，而非直接參與破壞系統。選項 B 與文中強調的「攻擊」性質相反；選項 C 描述的是政府監管者而非執行者；選項 D 則是這些計畫要對付的目標，而非企業扮演的角色。
